how: Every curated title was matched against the full IMDb dataset (1,28,85,817 rows) held in filmiset_all_world_master_15m.db, first on the exact normalised name and then on a looser form that ignores punctuation and spaces.

why_titles_miss.named_differently_on_imdb: Anime in particular: 'Haikyu!!', 'Re:ZERO', 'Ajin: Demi-Human', 'Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War'. The title is real, IMDb spells it another way.
why_titles_miss.two_titles_in_one_row: Rows like 'Avatar & Avatar: The Way of Water' or 'Avengers: Endgame & Infinity War' — Gemini merged two entries into one cell.
why_titles_miss.stage_plays: IMDb does not catalogue theatre. Gujarati, Marathi and Bengali nataks will never match.
why_titles_miss.genuinely_fabricated: Generic descriptive phrases in the languages Gemini knows least: 'Songs of the Himalayas', 'Chhath: The Sun Festival', 'Manganiyars: Desert Melodies', 'Bodo Weaves: Dokhona'.

fabrication_pattern: Invented entries look like '<Thing>: The <Concept>' and cluster in Santali, Bodo, Chhattisgarhi, Dogri, Sindhi, Tulu and Garhwali. Real titles are short and specific. Hindi, Marathi, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu and Hollywood verified at 91-100%.

per_file.curated_gujarati: 40% — nataks are stage plays, which IMDb does not list

already_removed: The All-Regions PDF was checked the same way before import: 191 of 280 kept, 89 held back (see curated_india_all_rejected.json).
